title: Unified telemetry adaptor for edge-to-core log normalization and trace handoff
creator: Aisha Kline
description: Build a unified telemetry adaptor that normalizes logs from edge agents and legacy syslog collectors into a compact, schema-first representation before routing to core aggregation systems (Loki/Elasticsearch). Goals: reduce ingestion costs by eliminating redundant fields, preserve cross-request trace handoff identifiers without leaking tenant-sensitive metadata, auto-detect and adapt to common vendor log formats (Fluentd/Vector/rsyslog), and provide backpressure-friendly batching so edge proxies can retry without data loss. Deliverables: adaptor binary + helm chart, transformation rules config, onboarding docs, Confluence schema catalog, end-to-end perf benchmark with 99th percentile latency targets.
comments: 2025-11-12 - Aisha Kline: Ticket created after spike that showed high tokenization overhead for unnormalized JSON payloads at the edge. Proposal: canonical compact schema with type hints to reduce ES document size.

2025-11-14 - Marco Ruiz: Initial adaptor prototype ingesting Vector HTTP output. Early findings: nested arrays and some vendor fields (event.context.*) cause mapping explosions in ES; added 'flattenDepth' config to reduce cardinality.

2025-11-16 - Design review (Emily Park): Reviewed schema catalog draft. Decision: include a lightweight canonical_trace_id field (hex, 64-bit) and keep raw_trace_headers as optional base64 to satisfy debug workflows while defaulting to redacted form in production.

2025-11-17 - Performance note (Kenji Tanaka): Benchmarked with 10k rps single-threaded adaptor; prefix-trie matcher reduced format detection CPU by 28% compared to regex fallback. Still spikes at 95th under bursty multitenant ingestion; plan to add circuit-breaker per-tenant.

2025-11-18 - Security review (SLO): Verified KMS integration for secrets used by the adaptor to decrypt forwarded headers. Added policy to strip PII keys by default and whitelist debugging modes behind a feature flag.

2025-11-19 - PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/telemetry-adaptor/pull/142 — contains schema-discovery engine, backpressure-aware batching, and Helm chart. Needs e2e tests against Loki and ES runners.

2025-11-20 - QA update (Lina Gómez): Smoke tests pass for Loki path; ES mapping tests reveal a corner-case with dotted field names causing nested mapping conflicts. Adding a migration script to canonicalize dotted keys to underscore-separated keys.
Next steps: add tenant-level rate limiting, finalize helm values for private deployments, add canary rollout in staging with 20% traffic, and schedule a runbook for rollback on mapping regressions.
